plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.slopes: integer 0..90; non-steep <= maximum; unselected navigation requires 55/55 and false flags
plan.offmesh_connections: explicitly unsupported in v1; empty only

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability, encryption-key discovery or a complete archive snapshot; every read still requires complete content MD5

resume: explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; complete output refuses writes
empty_world: complete empty Map direct rows plus validated liquid startup and pure empty navigation plan admit zero navigation artifacts for All only

verification.db2: complete bounded catalog decoding; exact selected name set
verification.gt: all 20 exact names; 14 numeric, six raw-only
verification.cameras: exact discovered raw file set from selected complete CinematicCamera; no M2 parsing
verification.maps: canonical names, selected map/tile scope, MAPS10/build and tilelist framing
verification.vmaps: VMAP_4.E intrinsic dtree/VMO/tree/tile/index framing and per-tree ordinal bounds
verification.mmaps: canonical selected names, MMAP16/Detour7 framing, no offmesh records
not_claimed: original C++ byte parity for newly produced worlds

failure: stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no hidden available-prefix, native, network or missing-file fallback
